name.zh: 假途灭虢：汴州→江陵→长沙

description.zh: 宋军南下经荆南假道，先灭荆南江陵，再南进灭马楚长沙。
description.en: Song forces borrowed passage through Jingnan, seized Jiangling, then advanced south to conquer Ma Chu at Changsha.

name.en: Conquest of Later Shu: northern route Bianzhou → Chengdu

description.zh: 王全斌军从北路入蜀，经兴州、利州南下成都。
description.en: Wang Quanbin's army entered Shu from the north, through Xingzhou and Lizhou.

name.zh: 灭后蜀：东线汴州→夔州→成都
name.en: Conquest of Later Shu: eastern route Bianzhou → Kuizhou → Chengdu

description.zh: 刘光义军自汴州南下，经夔州入蜀；示意图为陆路推进，未按长江水道逐段绘制。
description.en: Liu Guangyi's army moved south from Bianzhou and entered Shu via Kuizhou; this schematic shows an overland advance rather than the Yangtze channel.

name.en: Conquest of Southern Han: Bianzhou → Guangzhou

description.zh: 潘美军南下经衡州、贺州，水陆并进至广州。
description.en: Pan Mei advanced through Hengzhou and Hezhou with combined land and water forces.

name.en: Conquest of Southern Tang: Bianzhou → Jinling

description.zh: 曹彬军南下，沿淮河、长江东进，围金陵。
description.en: Cao Bin's army advanced east along the Huai and Yangtze rivers to besiege Jinling.

name.en: Conquest of Northern Han: Bianzhou → Taiyuan

description.zh: 宋太宗赵光义亲征太原，先败辽援军，后破城。
description.en: Emperor Taizong personally led the campaign against Taiyuan, defeated Liao reinforcements, and conquered the city.
